* Prepare, schedule, and execute training to cover emergency procedures, workplace safety, and other relevant topics
* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring and continuous improvement of environmental health and safety programs
* Conduct risk assessments of work sites to identify potential hazards and formulate plans to mitigate them
* Coordinate with insurance carriers to ensure that appropriate coverage is in place to cover any potential risks
* Review the employee accident reports and medical claims to evaluate the need for potential changes to current policies or procedures
* Consult with engineers to ensure that building designs are safe and compliant with current regulations
* Performs other related duties as required and assigned

* Experience in Manufacturing or production environment

* Must pay high attention to detail and have strong interpersonal, communication, and observation skills

existing_roles.title: VP of Operations
existing_roles.description:
**VP of Operations**

TekConcierge | Richardson, TX (moving to Denton, TX in 2027) | Hybrid | Full-Time

*Maintenance is a myth. Every company is moving forward or backward. There is no neutral gear. At TekConcierge, we’ve chosen forward, and we’re looking for the operator who will build the engine that gets us there.*

**About TekConcierge**

For 16 years, TekConcierge has been the trusted technology partner for businesses across more than 15 industries, including private equity, family offices, RIAs and financial services, oil and gas, manufacturing, automotive, accounting, and hospitality. We deliver managed IT, cybersecurity, and compliance services, including CMMC and DFARS for defense contractors, to organizations that can’t afford downtime or risk.

Today we’re a ~55-person, $12M+ company. We have a clear plan to reach $50M in the next five years and $100M within ten, driven by organic growth, a major investment in marketing, and acquiring IT companies that fit our culture and strategy.

We don’t chase growth for ego. We see growth as stewardship. It builds a financial fortress that protects our team, equips our people for an AI-driven future, and elevates careers so no one has to leave TekConcierge to grow. We call it our Growth Covenant: **Protect · Equip · Elevate.**

We measure success in three words: **Grow · Give · Win.** Profit isn’t the finish line; it’s fuel for generosity, profit participation, investment in our people, and Kingdom-impact giving. We are a faith-driven, servant-led company. We use EOS as our operating guardrails, and we’re adopting The Great Game of Business so every team member understands the scoreboard and shares in the wins.

**The Role**

The VP of Operations owns the end-to-end operating system that turns what we sell into predictable, profitable, measurable client delivery. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll lead the managers of a 25–30 person organization across:

* Service Desk / NOC

* Field & Onsite Technicians

* Projects, Onboarding & Client Transitions

* Procurement

As TekConcierge grows, the role may take on additional company-wide responsibilities. You’ll partner closely with our Chief Growth Officer, CFO, Sales leadership, Technical Operations Lead, and CISO. Your job is to own the seams: the handoffs between Sales, onboarding, projects, and day-to-day support where client experience is won or lost. Functional leaders keep their expertise and authority; you make sure the whole system delivers.

**Authority to lead:** You’ll have the executive sponsorship and decision rights to establish the delivery operating model, lead the responsible managers, recommend organizational changes, enforce readiness standards, and hold cross-functional owners accountable for agreed commitments.

**This is not a turnaround.** You’ll inherit an established company, experienced functional leaders, recurring clients, mature MSP platforms, and an executive team committed to investing in operations. The next stage of growth needs a more scalable operating model. You’ll build it.

**Strategic and Hands-On**

You think strategically and stay close to the work. You can open a ticket, see how the technician solved it, and coach a faster, first-time fix. Success means strong managers and an operating rhythm that runs without executive rescue.

**Your First 90 Days**

* **Days 1–30, Baseline:** Map the delivery lifecycle, review performance and capacity, and define the first operational scorecard.

* **Days 31–60, Control:** Launch weekly delivery reviews, put readiness gates on new projects and onboardings, and create one view of active work, risks, and capacity.

* **Days 61–90, Scale:** Publish the delivery lifecycle, forecast capacity against the sales pipeline, start root-cause reviews on reopened tickets, and present a 12-month roadmap.

**Your First 12 Months**

1. **Standardize how we work.** Build one documented delivery lifecycle from signed agreement to steady-state support, with SOPs and playbooks in Autotask and IT Glue. Put ITIL-aligned practices and formal change management controls in place so improvements stick.

2. **Build operations that scale.** Design the structure, capacity planning, and systems that absorb rapid organic growth and future acquisitions without sacrificing service quality.

3. **Build the bench and reshape the Service Desk.** Develop and promote future managers, strengthen accountability, and partner with Service Desk leadership to redesign the model, including a potential move to pods.

**What You’ll Own**

* **End-to-end delivery:** Clear stage gates, owners, and handoffs from signed agreement through onboarding, projects, and support, with operational readiness and capacity validated before commitments are made.

* **The operational scorecard:** SLA attainment, response and resolution, backlog aging, first-time fix, reopen and escalation rates, and CSAT, reviewed weekly and driven relentlessly.

* **Quality and root cause:** Review tickets and reopens, lead root-cause reviews on recurring issues and client-impacting failures, and turn lessons into coaching, documentation, and better process.

* **Projects and onboarding:** Sold vs. actual hours, scope changes, and clean handoffs, so projects land on time and profitably.

* **Capacity and workforce:** A rolling capacity forecast that combines support demand, projects, onboarding, and growth, translated into hiring, training, and automation plans.

* **Financial performance:** Partner with the CFO on budgets and forecasts, and own the operating drivers: gross margin by service line, labor efficiency, utilization, effective hourly rate, project profitability, and vendor costs.

* **Client retention:** Connect operational performance to client health and renewal risk.

* **Acquisition integration:** Support operational due diligence and lead the integration of acquired companies’ people, clients, tools, and processes.

* **AI and automation:** Use our PSA, RMM, automation, and AI to grow output faster than headcount.

* **Compliance in practice:** Partner with the CISO to embed SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and CMMC into daily delivery.

* **Leadership and culture:** Run the operating rhythm, model our core values, and teach every team member how the business wins.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of senior operations leadership (Director, VP, or COO level) running a complex, SLA-driven, recurring-service organization. MSP, IT, or cybersecurity services experience is strongly preferred; exceptional operators from hospitality, field services, or telecom are also welcome.

* Accountability for service delivery, project delivery, and client onboarding, leading managers and technical teams of 25+.

* Proven financial accountability: you’ve built budgets and forecasts and driven gross margin, labor efficiency, and profitability.

* A track record of building processes, operational controls, change management, and scorecards where few existed.

* Working knowledge of PSA and RMM environments and the data it takes to run an MSP.

* A strong technical foundation: your skills are sharp enough to review a ticket and coach a better solution.

* Experience leading large-scale projects and automation initiatives, and supporting regulated or audit-sensitive clients.

* You connect work across departments while respecting functional ownership.

* Genuine alignment with our core values and servant-leadership culture.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, IT, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Autotask and IT Glue (or ConnectWise, HaloPSA, Kaseya, or Datto)

* ITIL 4; PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or Prosci

* Leading in a SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 environment; NIST CSF, CIS Controls, CMMC, or DFARS

* Integrating an acquisition or major client transition; pod-based service delivery

* Applying AI to service operations, quality review, and knowledge management

* EOS, The Great Game of Business, or open-book management

We care more about demonstrated results than a perfect résumé. If you’ve built disciplined service operations, developed strong managers, and improved client and financial outcomes, apply even if you don’t check every box.

**Our Core Values**

* **Authentic:** We’re honest, genuine, and empathetic.

* **Professional:** We’re self-motivated, reliable, hardworking, proficient, and trustworthy team players. We’re winners, and we never stop learning.

* **Help First:** We help the client first, and the money follows. We follow through, do whatever it takes, and bring a high level of commitment, organization, and communication to every relationship.

* **Solutions-Focused:** We’re tenacious. We get things done. We solve business problems through technology.

**What We Offer**

* Executive-level base salary plus annual performance incentive

* Long-term incentive eligibility for the right leader

* A seat at the leadership table of a company in a deliberate growth and acquisition phase

* An open-book culture where wins are shared and celebrated together

* Paid vacation, health insurance, dental, and 401(k)

**Location and Expectations**

Hybrid, based at our Richardson, TX office with 3–4 days per week onsite. This is a North Texas role, not a fully remote position. Our office relocates to Denton, TX in 2027, so North DFW is ideal. Expect occasional travel to client sites and participation in executive escalations for major incidents (not a replacement for our on-call structure).

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume along with a short note (under 200 words) answering this question:

***“Tell us about a time you built or rebuilt an operation to scale. What did you change, and what happened to the numbers?”***

Applications are reviewed directly by our CEO and executive leadership. Finalists will present a proposed first-90-day plan for TekConcierge. No recruiters or agencies, please.

*TekConcierge is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

Pay: $150,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan

existing_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing and Operational Excellence
existing_roles.description:
**We are Proud to be SJE!**

At **SJE**, we are more than a company — we are a family of brands with a shared vision and mission to provide industry-leading, innovative, and reliable control and monitoring solutions that improve efficiencies, protect the environment, and deliver dependable solutions to our valued customers. We are looking for a **Director of Manufacturing and Operational Excellence** to support our SJE Revere brand.

Our Revere brand is a leading provider of automation and control solutions for the industrial, water and wastewater treatment, power and energy, manufacturing, food and beverage, oil and gas, and pulp and paper industries. We design, build, and implement customized automation and control systems for highly complex projects. **Check us out at** **Reverecontrol.com** (https://www.reverecontrol.com/) **or** **SJEinc.com** (https://sjeinc.com/)**!.**

**The job:**

The **Director of Manufacturing and Operational Excellence** provides leadership for SJE’s manufacturing network and drives the operating improvements required to support growth, quality, delivery, and profitability. This leader will build a more standardized, scalable manufacturing model across SJE ECS sites, with particular focus on panel manufacturing, PanelConnex manufacturing, automation, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.

The role will translate the Operations Strategy into execution: establishing common manufacturing standards, advancing the hub-and-spoke operating model, improving daily management practices, and leading investment decisions that increase capacity and reduce manufacturing complexity.

**The skills you need:**

What will you do in this role:

**Manufacturing Strategy and Network Development**

* Lead the development and implementation of the future-state manufacturing network, including hub-and-spoke roles, site capabilities, work-share processes, and capacity planning.
* Define which products, projects, and manufacturing activities should remain local versus move to manufacturing hubs or shared-service capabilities.
* Establish clear operating requirements for manufacturing hubs, spoke sites, and customer FAT locations.
* Lead the Ashland hub pilot and help develop the business case for expanded hub capabilities in Birmingham and a future Florida regional operations center.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain, Quality, and Commercial leaders to align demand, capacity, scheduling, and customer commitments.

**Continuous Improvement and Manufacturing Standardization**

* Build and lead a practical continuous improvement system across manufacturing locations.
* Standardize work instructions, routings, bills of material, quality requirements, visual management, 5S practices, and problem-solving methods.
* Establish and sustain Managing for Daily Improvement (MDI) routines that connect shop-floor issues to site and enterprise leadership action.
* Lead Kaizen events and improvement projects focused on safety, quality, labor productivity, flow, lead time, rework, and on-time delivery.
* Develop common manufacturing metrics, definitions, targets, and escalation thresholds across all sites.
* Ensure corrective actions address root causes and improve performance across the network, rather than only at an individual location.

**PanelConnex and Panel Manufacturing**

* Lead the manufacturing strategy and operating model for PanelConnex and other panel manufacturing businesses.
* Improve panel manufacturing consistency, quality, throughput, and labor efficiency across sites.
* Standardize panel design-to-build processes, including engineering handoff, materials, manufacturing instructions, testing, and final acceptance.
* Create a scalable approach for allocating panel work based on project complexity, customer needs, site capacity, and available technical capability.
* Support the growth of PanelConnex manufacturing while maintaining customer responsiveness and product quality.

**Manufacturing Automation and Digital Manufacturing**

* Develop and execute the manufacturing automation roadmap, including EPLAN, Smart Mounting, Smart Wiring, ModCenter, wire processing, and related production technologies.
* Identify automation opportunities that improve repeatability, reduce cycle time, increase labor flexibility, and expand shared manufacturing capacity.
* Build capital requests and investment cases using defined productivity, quality, capacity, safety, and financial outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering and IT to create a reliable digital thread from design through manufacturing, testing, and reporting.
* Ensure automation investments include standard work, training, maintenance plans, adoption measures, and clear performance expectations.

**Capacity, Performance, and Operational Leadership**

* Establish a common capacity-planning process that connects bookings, backlog, labor, materials, engineering readiness, and manufacturing schedules.
* Lead improvement plans for manufacturing constraints, including layout, staffing, shifts, equipment, material flow, and facility utilization.
* Monitor and improve core operational performance measures, including safety, first-pass yield, rework, on-time delivery, schedule adherence, manufacturing hours versus estimate, scrap, uptime, and test pass rate.
* Support site leaders in creating focused recovery plans when performance falls below target.
* Help evaluate manufacturing footprint decisions, including facility expansions, consolidations, make-versus-buy opportunities, and outsourced fabrication.

**People, Culture, and Change Leadership**

* Build the manufacturing and continuous-improvement leadership capability needed to support the operating strategy.
* Coach site leaders, manufacturing managers, engineers, and frontline teams in Lean methods, structured problem solving, standard work, and accountability.
* Promote a culture of safety, respect, employee engagement, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Support organizational design, succession planning, and hiring for manufacturing, automation, continuous improvement, quality, planning, and transformation roles.
* Communicate priorities and progress clearly across manufacturing sites and leadership forums.

**Measures of Success**

* Manufacturing standards and daily management practices are consistently deployed across sites.
* PanelConnex and panel manufacturing capacity, quality, and on-time delivery improve.
* Automation investments deliver measurable improvements in throughput, quality, labor efficiency, and cross-site capacity.
* The hub-and-spoke manufacturing model supports reliable work sharing and clearer site roles.
* First-pass yield improves while rework, test escapes, downtime, and material scrap decrease.
* Site capacity and performance visibility improve through common reporting, scheduling, and KPI definitions.
* Manufacturing teams demonstrate stronger problem-solving discipline, ownership, and follow-through.

**Education, Experience and Ability Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
* 12 or more years of progressive manufacturing or operations leadership experience, including multi-site responsibility.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing transformation, Lean implementation, continuous improvement, and standardized operating systems.
* Experience in electrical panel manufacturing, industrial controls, engineered-to-order manufacturing, automation, or a similar technical manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Experience implementing manufacturing automation and digital manufacturing tools, including engineering-to-production workflows.
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, 5S, visual management, value-stream improvement, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, and operational KPI management.
* Experience leading capital investment assessments and delivering measurable productivity, quality, capacity, or cost improvements.
* Ability to lead through influence across Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, HR, and Commercial teams.
* Willingness to travel regularly among SJE manufacturing locations.

**Answering your questions:**

When you are considering a new job, it is normal to have a ton of questions. Here are a few questions we are asked all the time.

* **What is your Flex Time Off and holiday policy?** Up six (6) weeks of Flex Time Off plus 8 paid holidays.
* **What benefits do you offer?** We offer a robust benefits package including health, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance as well as dental and vision programs you need to take care of your family, along with other benefit options**. Check out our** **full benefits package (http://www.sjeinc.com/benefits/)****!**

* **What percentage of travel is required for this position?** 30% - 50%

We will answer more of your questions during the first interview. Expect to hear about the next steps if you meet the job requirements.

**Why work with us:** 
At SJE, we believe in empowering our employees to grow professionally while making a real impact. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits, and a collaborative culture that encourages creativity and problem-solving. Join us and become a part of something bigger. Join a company where you’re not just working—you’re building a legacy!

Learn more and apply on-line at www.sjeinc.com (http://www.sjeinc.com/). SJE is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Opportunity Employer

existing_roles.title: Director of Contract Manufacturing
existing_roles.description:
**Position Summary:**

**The Director of Contract Manufacturing** focuses activities and resources in the organization around value creation and has responsibility for the success of the value stream. Unlike Steffes’ product-line business units, Contract Manufacturing does not own a product line; it markets and sells Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services, building to customer designs, specifications, and requirements.

The Director of Contract Manufacturing understands key system constraints, quickly identifies critical process issues and successfully maintains key customer relationships. Has management responsibility for the strategy, relationship management, pricing and margin.

This role must have excellent business, manufacturing, and technical knowledge; as well as interpersonal skills to communicate and be an influencer, both internal and external to the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintains responsibility for assigned business unit, including profitability, business development and budgeting.

* Develops sales and promotional strategies for Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services within the Value Stream.

* Sets vision, defines direction, influences and inspires others, aligns and leads teams to create value and grow the business.

* Responsible for increasing and tracking contract manufacturing revenue and market share.

* Responsible for advancing key customer relationships.

* Works with other department leaders to aid in allocation of resources and capacity to achieve specific business results.

* Coaches and assists team members.

* Sets clear expectations for the customer program life cycle, from quote through production and delivery, and ensures the team understands goals and expectations.

* Identifies risks and establishes suitable actions.

* Responsible for overall customer experience and customer care.

* Maintains a deep understanding of Steffes’ engineering and production processes, capabilities, and capacity.

* Ensures accurate and timely technical reviews of customer designs, drawings, and requirements.

* Establishes pricing based on cost estimates and market value such that market share and profitability goals can be met.

* Maintains a good understanding of competing contract manufacturers and engineering service providers, including their capabilities, marketing strategies, and relative costs. Be capable of effectively communicating this information with the sales department and other functional areas.

* Works with account managers to develop strategies to sell Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services to current and prospective customers.

* Ensures Steffes’ contract manufacturing services are competitive from the standpoint of quality, reliability, cost, lead time, and on-time shipping by calling out deficiencies and seeing proper action is initiated to correct problem areas.

* Monthly maintains financial forecasting and price reviews.

* Communicates with internal staff on a regular basis to understand their business problems and help find solutions.

* Maintains a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a collaborative manner with customers, suppliers, co-workers, and management.

* Helps company meet its Strategic, Quality, and Safety objectives.

* Assists with development and execution of annual sales plans.

* Establishes and maintains guidelines for pursuing and accepting new business.

* Daily monitors shipping activity, costing and pricing to ensure sales and profitability goals are being achieved.

* Assists CFO with review of Terms & Conditions and MSA’s and negotiates with the customer to resolve differences.

* Ensures prompt and satisfactory resolution to external quality issues on customer parts and assemblies.

* Other duties may be assigned

**Job Requirements/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering or equivalent experience preferred.
* 5 years of experience working in engineering, manufacturing, marketing, or sales
* Experience selling or managing engineering and/or contract manufacturing services with customers.
* Intermediate computer knowledge (Windows, email, internet, etc.)
* Written and verbal communication skills
* Overnight travel is required occasionally

-OR-

* An acceptable combination of education and experience

**Functional & Cognitive Requirements of Position**

* This position requires walking, sitting or standing to a significant degree.
* Must have the ability to lift 50 pounds from floor to waist, carry 50 pounds, and push and/or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Must have the ability to climb ladders and/or stairs.
* Stooping, crouching, kneeling and bending.
* Handling, feeling, and gripping would be required for some activities.
* Visual acuity is required to inspect work completed.
* This role may be subject to internal and external environmental conditions.
* Learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, make timely decisions in the context of a workflow, ability to communicate with visitors, ability to complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.

**Core Values:** 
**Trust:** We promote growth and long-term success by making wise decisions with trust as an essential component. 
**Respect:** We unleash creative talents of our diverse workforce by treating each other the way we would like to be treated. 
**Teamwork**: We believe people achieve much more by working together. 
**Integrity:** We follow through and keep our word while being open, honest, ethical, and fair. 
**Safety:** We view our co-workers as family members of our business and strive to ensure safety for all. • Humility: We recognize and appreciate strengths and contributions beyond one’s self. We are modest, genuine, and authentic. 
 
**Core Expectations:** 
**Customer Service** - Demonstrate excellent customer service and display a positive attitude and behavior consistent with the Steffes Code of Conduct and Core Values. 
**Environmental, Health, Safety (EHS)** – Perform work in compliance with EHS training and identified procedures/standard work. Report any EHS incident or concern to your supervisor immediately. Cooperate and contribute to the overall success of the EHS program. 
**Quality** – Participate in job-specific training. Complete work as indicated by standard work, processes, and/or procedures. If your work can’t be completed as required, notify your supervisor immediately for guidance. 
**Conduct** - Demonstrate and support the Steffes Code of Conduct. 
**Policies and Procedures** - Demonstrate and support Steffes Policies and Procedures by: 
o Using tact, sound judgement, and maintaining a professional attitude in communication and relationships with others. 
o Striving to deliver the best quality in daily work. 
o Promoting a positive image of Steffes and its products. 
o Being timely and punctual in attendance and following all policies and procedures.

*Equal Opportunity Employer*

existing_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer**

existing_roles.description:
Job Summary 
Maker’s Pride is seeking a proven, enterprise-minded Plant Director to lead our largest manufacturing facility in McComb, Ohio, a site of more than 1,600 Team Members that is critical to the success of our business. The Plant Director holds full accountability for the safety, quality, service, cost, and people performance of a large-scale co-manufacturing operation, and serves as the senior leader on site and the face of the plant to customers, Team Members, and the community. 
This role requires a seasoned operations executive who has led large, complex plants of 1,000+ Team Members, can build and develop a strong leadership bench, and can balance day-to-day execution with long-term strategy. The Plant Director partners closely with senior leadership and corporate functions to deliver the plant’s operating plan, drive operational excellence, and position McComb for sustained growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Operational Leadership: Lead all plant operations, including production, packaging, maintenance, engineering, quality, warehouse, and supply chain, to consistently deliver safety, quality, service, and cost targets across multiple shifts and lines.
* P&L and Financial Accountability: Own the plant’s operating plan, budget, and financial performance, including labor, overtime, yield, waste, and capital spend. Identify and execute cost-reduction and margin-improvement opportunities.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and execute a multi-year plant strategy aligned to enterprise goals, covering capacity, capital investment, automation, new business onboarding, and talent.
* Production Planning and Capacity: Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, and Customer teams to build production schedules and resource plans that optimize throughput, labor utilization, and on-time, in-full performance.
* Quality and Food Safety: Ensure strict adherence to quality, food safety, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, GMP, HACCP, and customer and third-party audit standards). Drive corrective and preventive actions and maintain audit readiness at all times.
* Safety Culture: Champion a zero-harm culture. Enforce safety policies, lead regular audits and incident reviews, and hold the leadership team accountable for proactive hazard prevention and compliance.
* Workforce Strategy and Labor Relations: Partner with HR to attract, retain, and engage a large and diverse workforce. Drive staffing stability, reduce turnover, manage overtime effectively, and foster positive Team Member and labor relations, including compliance with applicable employment and labor laws and agreements.
* Customer and Partner Relationships: Serve as the senior site representative with co-manufacturing customers, hosting visits and audits, resolving escalations, and building long-term trust. Collaborate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead a data-driven operational excellence program using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies to eliminate waste, improve OEE and yield, and standardize best practices across shifts.
* Capital and Asset Management: Oversee capital planning, project execution, and asset reliability to ensure equipment, infrastructure, and facilities support safe, efficient, and scalable operations.
* Reporting and Executive Communication: Provide regular, transparent reporting on safety, quality, production, financial, and workforce KPIs to senior leadership, with clear analysis, risks, and recommendations.
* Community and Site Presence: Represent Maker’s Pride in the McComb community and maintain a visible, accessible leadership presence on the plant floor across all shifts.

Supervisory Responsibilities

* Leadership of a Large Organization: Provide direct leadership to the plant leadership team and overall leadership of 1,600+ Team Members, including managers, supervisors, technicians, and support staff.
* Talent Development: Build a strong leadership bench through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and development of high-potential leaders.
* Culture and Accountability: Foster a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, respect, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 7+ years in a senior plant leadership role (Plant Manager, Plant Director, or equivalent).
* Scale: Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multi-shift plants of 1,000+ Team Members, with full P&L accountability.
* Industry: Experience in co-manufacturing, food, beverage, or other high-volume, regulated manufacturing environments strongly preferred.
* Operational Excellence: Track record of delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and cost. Lean, Six Sigma, or similar certification desirable.
* Workforce Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop a large, diverse workforce, including strong experience with staffing, retention, and employee and labor relations. Experience in a unionized environment is a plus.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, food safety and quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Technology: Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite; experience with manufacturing software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is a plus.
* Leadership Skills: Strategic thinker with excellent executive presence, communication, and decision-making skills; able to influence at all levels of the organization and with customers.
* Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

The information provided in this document provides an overview of the most common duties, qualifications, and demands of the position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive summary of the role, and the duties, qualifications, and demands of the position are subject to change without notice. The expectations provided here may also be modified if an employee with a disability could effectively meet the expectations for the role with reasonable accommodation.

existing_roles.title: Operations Director
existing_roles.description:
Gotion Inc. is based in Silicon Valley, CA, currently building a Manufacturing facility in Manteno, IL and has R&D centers in Ohio, China, Japan and Europe. We innovate in the next generation electric vehicle and energy storage technologies (lithium batteries and related systems) with the aim to accelerate electrified transportation and achieve sustainable development. Gotion is powered by a leading power battery technology company that provides solutions for vehicles including the world's first mass commercial e-bus route. 
 
Gotion is a career destination - we are not simply attempting to just fill another job, but to pursue a dream of global green energy together! We offer outstanding opportunities to individuals seeking an exciting and challenging working environment. Everyone is highly valued and plays a vital role in the growth of our organization.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Director is responsible for leading and coordinating key operational functions of the manufacturing facility, including **Production Planning, Supply Chain, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and Infrastructure/Construction Engineering**.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring production readiness, material availability, operational continuity, regulatory compliance, facility development, and cross-functional execution.

The Operations Director will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and other functional leaders to support safe, efficient, and scalable operations of the Chicago manufacturing facility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Operations Coordination**

* Lead production planning and scheduling based on demand, capacity, materials, and priorities.
* Develop and manage short- and long-term production plans.
* Coordinate manpower, equipment, and materials to achieve production targets.
* Monitor plan execution and identify delivery risks.
* Drive cross-functional efforts to resolve production and operational constraints.
* Track key KPIs, including production attainment, inventory, material availability, delivery, and efficiency.
* Support S&OP and capacity planning processes.

* **Supply Chain Management**

* Lead plant supply chain operations, including production planning, materials, procurement, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.
* Ensure material availability while maintaining optimal inventory levels.
* Improve inventory turnover and reduce excess and obsolete stock.
* Drive supplier performance and supply continuity.
* Identify supply chain risks and implement contingency plans.
* Manage domestic and international logistics activities.
* Lead continuous improvement in cost, efficiency, and delivery performance.

* **Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

* Lead the plant's EHS programs and team to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.
* Promote a strong safety culture and drive workplace safety initiatives.
* Oversee inspections, risk assessments, corrective actions, and emergency preparedness.
* Monitor EHS performance and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to improve safety and compliance.
* Support regulatory audits, inspections, and permitting activities.

* **Infrastructure & Construction Engineering**

* Lead facility engineering, infrastructure, and construction projects supporting plant operations.
* Oversee plant expansion, renovations, and infrastructure improvements.
* Manage contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Ensure projects meet scope, budget, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.
* Maintain critical facility systems, utilities, and infrastructure readiness.
* Support production line installation, commissioning, and facility startup activities.

* **Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Management**

* Establish and manage operational processes across planning, supply chain, EHS, and infrastructure.
* Lead operational reviews and drive action item completion.
* Identify and escalate operational risks to plant leadership.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, cost, delivery, inventory, and efficiency.
* Drive KPI-based decision-making and operational visibility.
* Support ERP/MRP and digitalization initiatives.
* Foster collaboration across Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, HR, and IT.

* **Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor managers and operational teams.
* Establish organizational structure, goals, and succession plans.
* Recruit, develop, and retain key talent.
* Drive performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a collaborative, safety-focused, high-performance culture.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* **10+ years of progressive experience** in manufacturing operations, supply chain, production planning, engineering, or related functions.
* **5+ years of leadership experience** managing managers and/or multiple operational functions.
* Strong experience in large-scale manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience in production planning, supply chain management, and plant operations.
* Working knowledge of EHS management and U.S. regulatory requirements.
* Experience supporting facility construction, plant expansion, infrastructure, or manufacturing engineering projects strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ERP/MRP systems; SAP experience preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **lithium-ion battery, EV, automotive, energy storage, electronics, or advanced manufacturing**.
* Experience supporting the launch or ramp-up of a new manufacturing facility in the United States.
* Experience managing complex global supply chains.
* Familiarity with high-volume automated manufacturing environments.
* Experience working with international and cross-cultural teams.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, S&OP, inventory optimization, and operational excellence methodologies.
* PMP, APICS/CPIM/CSCP, Six Sigma, or related professional certification is a plus.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Key performance measures may include:

**Production Planning:** Production Plan Attainment | Capacity Utilization | Schedule Adherence

**Supply Chain:** On-Time Delivery | Material Availability | Inventory Turns | Inventory Accuracy | Logistics Cost

**EHS:** Safety Incident Rate | Corrective Action Closure | Regulatory Compliance | Environmental Performance

**Infrastructure:** Project Schedule | Project Budget | Construction Safety | Facility Readiness | Utility Reliability

**Overall Operations:** Cost Reduction | Operational Efficiency | Risk Management | Cross-Functional Execution

**Leadership Scope**

The Operations Director provides leadership and management oversight for:

**Production Planning / PMC**

**Supply Chain & Logistics**

**Warehouse & Inventory**

**Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

**Infrastructure / Construction / Facility Engineering**

Position Overview

We are partnering with an established, innovative manufacturer of advanced semiconductor capital equipment to identify an experienced Director of Manufacturing Operations.

This highly visible leadership position is responsible for overseeing a complex manufacturing organization, driving operational excellence, and ensuring the successful assembly, integration, testing, and delivery of sophisticated capital equipment systems.

The ideal candidate is a decisive, hands-on operations leader who thrives in a fast-paced, technically complex manufacturing environment. This individual will bring a strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to develop high-performing teams, solve challenging operational problems, and consistently deliver against customer commitments.

This role requires a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable managing day-to-day factory execution, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and communicating manufacturing performance, financial results, and operational strategy to executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Operations & Execution

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across sub-assembly, system assembly, integration, and final test functions.
* Take direct ownership of manufacturing performance, including on-time shipments, product quality, production schedules, and customer commitments.
* Establish and execute manufacturing strategies aligned with organizational objectives, customer requirements, and business growth.
* Identify and resolve production bottlenecks, resource constraints, and operational challenges to maintain consistent factory output.
* Drive operational accountability through clearly defined performance metrics, structured problem-solving, and decisive leadership.
* Ensure manufacturing capacity, staffing, and production resources are aligned with business demand.

Financial & Operational Management

* Develop and manage manufacturing operating budgets, resource plans, labor utilization, and production costs.
* Monitor and communicate key financial and operational metrics, including manufacturing output, revenue-related shipment performance, labor overhead, operating expenses, and production capacity.
* Present manufacturing performance, operational risks, and improvement initiatives to senior executive leadership.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, resource utilization, and overall manufacturing productivity.
* Support strategic business planning through accurate capacity assessments, operational forecasting, and data-driven decision-making.

Leadership & Organizational Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop a manufacturing organization consisting of production managers, supervisors, engineers, technicians, and operational support personnel.
* Establish a culture of accountability, ownership, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate organizational capabilities, identify leadership gaps, and implement development plans to strengthen management effectiveness.
* Make timely, well-informed decisions to address performance issues, operational challenges, and organizational needs.
* Build a high-performance manufacturing culture focused on execution, safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Promote effective cross-functional collaboration with engineering, quality, supply chain, and executive leadership.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Champion a proactive safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable manufacturing safety and quality standards.
* Drive improvements in product quality, first-pass yield, manufacturing consistency, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead structured root-cause investigations and corrective action initiatives using methodologies such as 8D, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and statistical process control.
* Develop and execute continuous improvement roadmaps focused on cycle-time reduction, process efficiency, waste elimination, and operational scalability.
* Implement proactive quality initiatives that identify and resolve manufacturing issues earlier in the production process.
* Maintain compliance with applicable ISO certifications and established quality management systems.

Manufacturing Engineering & Process Optimization

* Partner with engineering and manufacturing teams to improve product manufacturability, assembly efficiency, and test effectiveness.
* Drive improvements in manufacturing test strategies, including modular testing, parallel test execution, and automated test methods.
* Identify opportunities to reduce final system test cycle times while maintaining rigorous product quality standards.
* Support new product introductions, engineering changes, and production transitions to ensure manufacturing readiness.
* Collaborate with global suppliers and contract manufacturing partners to support production requirements and operational objectives.
* Lead manufacturing-related insourcing, outsourcing, and production transfer initiatives as required.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing or operations, including at least 5 years in a manufacturing operations leadership role within the semiconductor capital equipment industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex capital equipment manufacturing operations, including assembly, integration, testing, and final product delivery.
* Proven accountability for factory performance, production output, on-time shipments, manufacturing quality, and operational execution.
* Strong financial and business acumen, including experience managing manufacturing budgets, labor costs, overhead, capacity planning, and production-related financial performance.
* Ability to communicate operational results, financial performance, manufacturing risks, and strategic recommendations effectively to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing teams and developing managers in a demanding, high-performance environment.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, structured problem-solving, quality management systems, and data-driven operational improvement.
* Decisive leadership style with a demonstrated ability to solve problems, make difficult decisions, and drive accountability across an organization.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience manufacturing sophisticated semiconductor processing or precision capital equipment systems.
* Experience leading manufacturing organizations of approximately 100 employees, including multiple direct-report managers.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Electrical Sector Americas - ARS/Fibrebond division is currently seeking a Plant Manager for its manufacturing operations in Minden, Louisiana. This role is a critical member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading safe, high-quality, on-time, and cost-effective operations. Relocation assistance is available to candidates currently residing in the U.S. 
 
In this role, you will lead the Minden manufacturing site and its leadership team. You will drive strategic and operational initiatives including plant P&L, growth strategy, capacity, execution, and the direction of the team to meet and exceed short- and long-term business goals. You will foster an environment of engagement and inclusion for all employees and act with advocacy, empathy, and accountability. 
 
Fibrebond, an Eaton company, designs and manufactures pre-integrated modular buildings and power enclosures that protect mission-critical equipment for data center, industrial, utility, and communications customers. Headquartered in Minden, Louisiana, Fibrebond is known for its engineered-to-order solutions that support complex infrastructure projects across North America. In 2025, Fibrebond was acquired by Eaton, expanding Eaton's modular solutions portfolio while preserving Fibrebond's strong engineering expertise, customer focus, and manufacturing operations in Louisiana. 
 
**What you’ll need:** 

* Develop short- and long-term plans in alignment with the strategic plan and annual profit plan objectives to drive superior operational performance and financial results.
* Lead the operational management team and functional staff including Quality, OPEX, EHS and Supply Chain.
* Establish objectives and drive Key Performance Indicators across the organization ensuring continuous improvement.
* Emphasize utilization of Lean/Six Sigma manufacturing tools (Kaizen, VSM, 5S+) to lead cost improvement
* Establish and manage inventory to profit plan, driving improved and sustainable processes; execute the Supply Demand Planning (SIOP), drive ownership and collaboration across all stakeholder groups; generate forecasts that meet customer expectations.
* Champion a workplace focused on Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) to drive a zero-incident safety culture.
* Focus on Quality, early detection and escalations across the site to reduce cost, drive efficiency and ensure compliance.
* Create a culture of exceeding customer expectations, ensuring that the organization is highly responsive to customer needs.
* Demonstrate the ability to be innovative by developing and implementing creative solutions to complex problems, fostering a culture of innovation and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with Human Resources to drive talent management, learning, communication, and development strategies.
* Champion and advocate for a winning plant culture aligned with the Eaton Culture Model

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution
* 10+ years of experience with progressive levels of accountability and responsibility in roles focused on manufacturing, supply chain, finance, OPEX and/or related support functions in a manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of people-management experience
* Must be able to travel as business needs require.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position.This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

 
**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* MBA from an accredited institution
* Previous experience leading a complex engineered-to-order manufacturing operation through growth, capacity expansion, operational transformation.
* Plant P&L leadership experience with strong business acumen.
* 3+ years of experience as a leader of leaders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* This role will be based at our Fibrebond manufacturing plant in Minden, LA.
* Relocation will be offered for this position.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re all about propelling the next generation of leaders forward. We are driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. We deliver innovative solutions that make our customers’ lives easier—helping them power, protect, and intelligently manage their homes and businesses. To do this, we need creative and talented people to join our company.

We offer a dynamic work environment and a unified and inclusive culture. NRG fosters a strong sense of belonging that leads to better collaboration and business performance. Our company programs are designed to help employees develop the skills they need for success now and in the future. In everything we do, we aim to champion our employees and bring value to our customers, investors and society.

More information is available at www.nrg.com. Connect with NRG on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for all aspects of Plant Operation and Maintenance, including P&L responsibility. Responsible for maintaining a competent, well-trained staff. Responsible for plant safety, training, environmental compliance, policy administration and has purchasing authority for required materials and services. Maintain good relationship with customers and the community. Responsible for supporting and executing Gas Plant Strategy in a dynamic financial climate. The Aurora and Rockford Generating simple cycle peaking plants are located outside of Chicago. Aurora Generation is a 1000 MW facility operating four GE 7FAs and six GE LM 6000 natural gas-fired combustion turbines. Rockford Generation is a 540MW facility operating three Siemens V84.3A2 natural gas-fired combustion turbines. The two sites are about 70 miles apart.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Supports and emphasizes importance of safety and environmental programs and ensures regulatory compliance
* Promotes productivity and teamwork with open communication, timely decision making, and use of leadership skills to set high standards of performance, while providing the direction necessary to achieve performance
* Promotes and supports the development of technical leadership and business skills of employees to carry out responsibilities in a competitive environment
* Responsible for matrix communications to NRG management
* Provides regular feedback to employees on their performance to allow them to capitalize on their strengths and focus on opportunities for improvement
* Creates and supports an organizational culture that encourages and rewards employee involvement, innovative thinking, adaptation to change, responsible risk taking, customer focus, and continuous improvement
* Formulates appropriate strategies which support the overall NRG strategy and manages development, implementation and execution of assigned area goals, objectives, and initiatives
* Manages all business aspects of assigned area to maximize competitive position of the plant including operational performance, staff development and cost management
* Reviews organizational performance with constituents and addresses opportunities for improvement on a regular basis
* Manages, as necessary, the evaluation and selection of external service providers.
* Manages work performed by external service providers in support of organizational objectives and responsibilities
* Assigns work and holds employees accountable for their performance
* Develops and maintains professional relationships with organizations external to the plant
* Ensures that appropriate technical expertise related to assigned area of responsibility is available and provided to employees in a timely manner.
* Manages development and execution of appropriate standards, guidelines, programs, and procedures within assigned area of responsibility
* Uses and maintains technical and professional knowledge, shares that knowledge with others, and recognizes/applies new technology in a cost-effective manner
* Obtains and applies knowledge of competitive business practices in daily work activities and decision making
* Seeks and understands the organizational needs and focuses on meeting and exceeding these requirements
* Anticipates, accepts and successfully implements necessary changes in the organization and adapts to meet the new requirements
* Ensure a safe and environmentally compliant workplace
* Willing to accept accountability for own decisions, performance, and behavior, as well as the performance of assigned staff
* Must be able to effectively interface with regulatory, political, business, civic and public representatives consistent with NRG corporate objectives

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Minimum of Bachelors degree in an Engineering or related technical discipline, and 10 years of equivalent experience in a related technical field; or a minimum of 14 years experience in a related technical field or similar position
* Demonstrated record of successfully leading/supervising employees in a related field
* Ability to split time between both sites

**Preferred:**

* Experience with GE 7FA, LM6000 and/or Siemens V84.3A2 preferred.
* Experience with remote operations a plus. Aurora responsible for the remote operation of 8 LM6000s in Texas at 4 different sites.

**Competencies:**
-----------------

* Uses and maintains technical and professional knowledge, shares that knowledge with others, and recognizes/applies new technology in a cost effective manner
* Obtains and applies knowledge of competitive business practices in daily work activities and decision making
* Seeks and understands the customer/client’s needs and focuses on meeting and exceeding their expectations
* Anticipates and accepts changes in the organization and adapts to meet the new requirements
* Committed to making the workplace safe and environmentally sound
* Willing to accept accountability for own decisions, performance, and behavior, as well as the performance of assigned employees.

**Working Conditions:**
-----------------------

* Power plant environment.
* Requires operation of a motor vehicle; active Driver’s License.
* Work overtime and non-standard working hours as required
* Requires occasional travel outside service area
* Requires wearing personal protective safety equipment (respirators, safety glasses, hard hat, appropriate footwear, ear plugs, etc.)
* Required to work around rotating and energized equipment, hazardous materials and chemicals
* Requires standing, sitting, walking, kneeling, twisting, climbing stairs and ladders, and entering plant equipment.
* Requires operation of a personal computer
* Occasionally requires lifting as appropriate to perform duties and responsibilities

Our company is a pioneer in the industrial packaging sector with a long history of customer-focused innovations in materials, processes and automation technology that have revolutionized the sector. 
 
Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we are proud to be the Transit Packaging Division of Crown Holdings, Inc. We are excited to go to market as Signode and to share the portfolio of products, services and capabilities that make us the world’s premier end-of-line packaging company.

 **Job Description**

**Benefits:**

Signode offers a comprehensive benefits package to full-time employees, which includes health, dental, vision, 401k, paid time off, life insurance, wellness perks, and more. Benefits begin the month following the hire date.

**Salary:**

The annual salary for this position ranges from $163,500 - $200,000 plus 20% bonus and varies based on specific responsibilities and geographic location. Starting annual salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and/or skillset.

**Summary**

This role is for a Plant Manager who is a true leader, one who can build a strong, positive culture throughout the plant. The position calls for a sharp operational and analytical mind that constantly seeks out, teaches, and leads improvements in Safety Performance, Cost Control, Standardized Processes (LEAN), Production Reporting, and Inventory Control.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to lead one of Signode’s most important locations, having a big impact on our ability to deliver a profitable year. Here is what makes this role stand out:

* Pilot the company’s Operational Excellence system, delivering a glidepath in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Output, and Morale.
* Take charge of a major turnaround facility. The right leader is confident yet humble, ready to run a 24/7 site from the bottom up, and understands the sweat and equity required to turn it around.
* Succeed here, and fast-track your path to the next level.

**Essential Functions**

* Directly manage and coordinate the activities of various plant departments and sites within Signode.
* Provide strong leadership to the manufacturing team, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented work environment.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve production goals, optimize processes, and enhance overall plant efficiency.
* Communicate, uphold and enforce safety protocols and regulatory compliance to maintain a safe and secure working environment.
* Responsible for talent management and employee lifecycle activities, from hiring to terminating.
* Collaborate with senior management to align plant operations with organizational objectives.
* Monitor and analyze production metrics, ensuring that production targets are met while maintaining high-quality standards.
* Implement efficiency improvement initiatives and address any bottlenecks or issues in the production process.
* Efficiently allocate resources, including manpower and equipment, to meet production schedules and deadlines.
* Collaborate with the maintenance team to ensure optimal functionality of machinery and equipment.
* Collaborate with the quality control department to ensure that products meet or exceed quality standards.
* Implement measures to address any deviations or non-conformities in the production process.
* Develop and manage budgets for the manufacturing facility(s), controlling costs and optimizing resource utilization.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement measures to improve overall plant profitability.
* Effectively communicate with senior management, department heads, and front-line staff to ensure clear understanding of goals and objectives.
* Prepare regular reports on plant performance, production metrics, and other relevant KPIs.
* Lead and support initiatives for continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance plant processes, reduce waste, and increase overall efficiency.

 
**Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Management, Business, or Engineering. Masters Degree in similar field preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum of 15+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, with at least 5 -7 years in a managerial or supervisory role. **Previous experience as a plant manager is a must.**

* Financial Acumen with the ability to analyze and forecast data and translate results to better solutions. With the understanding of general ledger accounting and activity rate costing.
* Strong knowledge of safety metrics and programs.
* TPM mastery
* **Previous experience leading a turnaround factory**
* Extrusion technical skills
* ERP system knowledge a plus.
* LEAN Manufacturing Training or CI Management Experience (Tier I, II, III)

**Functional Success Drivers:** These competencies are what we require for an individual to be successful in this role.

* Strategic Skills
* Leadership
* Result Oriented
* Safety & Security
* Communication (Oral & Written)
* Analytical Skills
* Inspiring “Followership”
* Vision

**About the Role**

Our transloading facility at Black, a grain operation just east of Friona on US 60, is hiring a Facility Manager to run the site. This is a hands on job. You manage the crew, you keep trucks and railcars moving, and you run our steam flaking (wheat) and extrusion (milo) processes. If you have led a crew, you know your way around equipment, and you want to run a facility instead of a shift, we would like to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

* Run day to day operations at the Black facility and set the daily schedule for the crew
* Supervise, train and hold accountable a crew of loader and plant operators
* Make sure trucks are loaded and unloaded on time using our large front-end loaders
* Manage railcar unloading and turn times so cars do not sit
* Manage the steam flaking and extrusion processes, including run settings, product quality and throughput
* Keep loaders, forklifts, the flaker, the extruder and the handling system in good working order
* Troubleshoot mechanical and equipment problems

**Qualifications**

* Previous supervisory or management experience. Grain, feed, dairy, feedyard, oilfield, construction and manufacturing all translate
* Bilingual English and Spanish strongly preferred, since much of our crew speaks Spanish
* Real mechanical ability. You can diagnose an engine, a hydraulic issue or a conveyor problem yourself before calling anyone
* A problem solver who makes the call rather than waiting for permission
* Grain processing experience preferred. Flaking, extruding, roller mills, elevators or feed milling
* Front-end loader and forklift experience preferred

**What you get**

* Small operation, no layers of management. You report straight to ownership, you have real authority over how the site runs, and when you fix something you see the result the same week.
* Health Insurance
* Opportunity to grow with us as a company

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM, with Saturday mornings during busy stretches.

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Plant Manager – Level 3 Water Treatment PlantNorth Greene Utilities (NGU)Baileyton, Tennessee

North Greene Utilities is seeking a certified Level 3 Water Treatment Plant Manager to lead operations at our Level 3 water treatment production plant in Baileyton Tennessee. This is a key leadership role responsible for the full management of plant functions, regulatory compliance, and a small team of operators.

Position Overview

The Plant Manager oversees all day-to-day and long-term operations of NGU’s Level 3 water treatment plant. The position ensures continuous production of safe, high-quality water that meets or exceeds all Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation (TDEC) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) standards and guidance. The manager supervises, mentors, and develops a team of three subordinates while maintaining efficient, safe, and compliant plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage all plant functions and treatment processes to meet TDEC and EPA regulatory requirements and policy guidance.• Supervise, mentor, and train three subordinates. Two subordinates are expected to achieve Level 1 certification by mid-2027.• Develop, implement, and manage shift schedules to ensure continuous, reliable plant coverage.• Ensure compliance with all federal and state safety regulations and NGU safety protocols.• Conduct lifecycle and operational management of treatment infrastructure, including maintenance planning and capital needs.• Participate in daily stand-up meetings with the NGU management team.• Assist with HR requirements for subordinates, including ensuring compliance with company policies.• Monitor the health and welfare of subordinates.• Conduct biannual performance counseling for subordinates.• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to evolving operational requirements and tasks as directed by the Operations Supervisor and General Manager.• Maintain accurate records, reporting, and documentation required for regulatory compliance and internal management.

Qualifications

* Current Tennessee Level 3 Water Treatment Operator certification (required).• Proven experience in water treatment plant operations, preferably in a leadership or supervisory role.• Strong knowledge of TDEC and EPA drinking water regulations, treatment processes, and compliance requirements.• Ability to supervise, train, and develop staff.• Valid driver’s license and ability to meet any additional job-related certifications or requirements (e.g., safety, drug and alcohol screening).• Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.• Commitment to safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

Compensation and Benefits

NGU offers very competitive wages, an IRA, health insurance, and dental coverage. Additional details on pay and benefits will be discussed with qualified candidates.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume, copy of current Level 3 certification, and contact information to .

For questions, contact the office at 423-234-3145.

Benefits:

* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

existing_roles.description:
Description:

**Who We Are**

Headquartered in Vineland, NJ, F&S Fresh Foods is leading the way in fresh-cut fruit, vegetables, and meal solutions distribution. With the recent acquisition of five additional state-of-the-art facilities strategically located across the U.S., we now deliver to customers across the United States and Canada — every single day!

For over 40 years, we’ve been redefining production and safety processes, building strong partnerships, and creating endless possibilities for our diverse customers — from restaurants and supermarket prepared food operations to convenience store chains and beyond. At F&S, we are fueling families with nutrition, innovation, and convenience, turning meals into memorable moments. By combining cutting-edge technology, deep-rooted customer relationships, and operational excellence, we are shaping the future of fresh — from farm to family.

We’re not just about food; we’re about people. Recognized as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, our team of 2,100 full-time employees drives our culture forward by living our values every day. If you’re ready to be part of a company that values innovation, excellence, and community impact, join us as we embrace our next exciting chapter of growth. Together, we’re planting the seeds of progress and nourishing a fresh, healthy future for everyone!

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* 401(K) including company match!
* Paid Time Off annually + Paid Holidays
* Career Advancement opportunities and Tuition Assistance

**What’s the Role**

The Vice President, Quality & Food Safety is F&S Fresh Foods’ senior executive leader for Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality across all of our facilities. This role sets the enterprise-wide strategy, standards, and systems that keep our products safe, consistent, and compliant with every regulatory, customer, and certification requirement. As the company’s senior authority on food safety risk, audit readiness, and crisis management, you will protect consumers, customers, and the F&S brand while partnering closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Product Development, Sales, and Executive Leadership. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven leader who earns the trust of customers and regulators, develops strong teams, and champions a culture where food safety and quality are everyone’s responsibility.

**What You’ll Own**

* Set and execute the long-term Quality and Food Safety strategy, including enterprise goals, standards, KPIs, and governance processes aligned with business objectives
* Lead all corporate Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality functions, ensuring consistent programs across all facilities
